verdicts.title: setLoans() has no access control: anyone can rewire loans/NFT and wipe the NAV list

a.reden: Both describe missing access control on PortfolioVault.setLoans allowing any address to call it

b.reden: The candidate describes the same missing access control on setLoans() in PortfolioVault.sol, which matches known finding H-01.

verdicts.title: setMaxNavComputationTime() is callable by anyone, letting an attacker DoS NAV updates

a.reden: Both describe missing access control on PortfolioVault.setMaxNavComputationTime allowing anyone to call it

b.reden: The candidate describes the same missing access control in setMaxNavComputationTime, leading to a DoS on NAV updates, exactly as known finding H-4.

verdicts.title: approveRedemption can burn shares for zero assets, leaving them unredeemable

a.reden: Both describe the missing require(assets > 0) check in PortfolioVault.approveRedemption

b.reden: The candidate describes the same missing require(assets > 0) check in approveRedemption, which is exactly the issue reported in H-02.

verdicts.title: setLoans does not re-validate the exchange or reset NFT-related state for the new pair

a.reden: The candidate describes a state‑validation issue in setLoans, which differs from the access‑control or off‑by‑one bugs listed in the known findings.

b.reden: The candidate describes stale exchange/NFT state after setLoans, not the known missing access control in setLoans.

verdicts.title: Anyone holding a loan NFT can grief NAV cycles and approvals by sending it to the vault

a.reden: The candidate describes a nonce/ NFT transfer issue in updateNav, which does not correspond to any of the listed missing access control, missing check, or off‑by‑one findings.

b.reden: The candidate describes a griefing vector via unsolicited NFT transfers to the vault affecting NAV cycles; none of the known findings relate to that issue.

verdicts.title: setExchange swaps the exchange while open offers and NFT approvals remain on the old exchange

a.reden: The candidate describes a logic flaw in setExchange and related offer handling, which does not correspond to any of the listed known findings.

b.reden: The candidate describes a different bug (stale approvals/offers when exchange is changed) not present in any of the known findings (access control, missing check, off-by-one).
